name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: 3 coins goes with exactly one of Cedric, Edmund, or Earl.
Edmund, Countess, and Earl go with 5 coins, 7 coins, and 9 coins, in some order.
Either Baron goes with 3 coins or 5 coins goes with Countess.
Matilda's levy is lower than both Edmund and the artisan serving the Countess.
Exactly one of these is true: Beatrix goes with 3 coins; Edmund goes with 5 coins; Countess goes with 7 coins.
